title: G3 Pass Decision
description: Run the replay-safe SCRUM-219 final G3 decision only after SCRUM-215 PASS, exact-head validations, current Ready-for-Review eligibility and closed findings are present for the same scope. Drift, rejected or missing evidence, non-success CI, stale review and unresolved blockers fail closed; G3 PASS never grants merge, deploy or production authority.
